description: B.Tech AI & Data Science student interested in AI, Earth science, data, and creative tech. Building a team for Earth Information Jukebox to turn Earth data into sound, visuals, and interactive experiences. Looking for teammates skilled in coding, AI/ML, data, web development, audio, design, or storytelling. 🌍🎧
summary:
Earth Information Jukebox is an interactive web application that converts Earth science visualizations into sound using sonification.

The application analyzes visual properties such as colour, brightness, density, and movement and maps them to audio using Tone.js. Users can explore four visualization tracks: Night Lights, Perpetual Ocean 2, Lightning from the ISS, and DYAMOND CO2, each designed around a NASA Earth Information Center visualization.

This prototype currently demonstrates the pipeline with generated placeholder frames, which are not NASA data. It is built to run on the NASA clips: users can load any downloaded video into a track with the “Load your own clip” button, and the same analysis and sound mapping are applied to it.

The project provides interactive controls, full-screen listening, keyboard and touch support, and audio recording.

Its main benefit is making Earth science more accessible and engaging, especially for people with visual impairments. It provides an alternative way to experience scientific information and understand patterns in our changing planet.

Technologies used include HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and Tone.js. The project combines science, music, and technology creatively to transform visual information into an interactive audio experience.

Our goal is to promote inclusive science communication and make Earth observation more engaging for everyone.
